topic: A/c controls systems; mechanical, power assisted fully powered & fly-by-wire type of controls surfaces.
syllabus_extract: A/c controls systems; mechanical, power assisted fully powered & fly-by-wire type of controls surfaces.
specific_objectives: 9.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to describe various Aircraft engineering systems.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of IB schematics; Instructor supervision required for diagram interpretation.
intro_questions: What are the three primary flight controls?
Define the function of the elevator.
List two types of control systems used in modern aircraft.

development.content:
Mechanical Control Systems
Cables and Push-pull Rods
Bell Cranks and Pulleys
Friction and Lubrication

Power Assisted Systems
Hydraulic Boost Mechanisms
Electro-Hydraulic Actuators
Fail-safe Features

Fully Powered Systems
Fly-by-Wire Architecture
Flight Control Computers
Redundancy and Safety

summary_questions: Explain the difference between mechanical and fly-by-wire controls.
Describe the role of flight control computers in a fully powered system.
Identify one safety feature common in power-assisted systems.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note comparing the mechanical linkage of LP 02 with the electronic signals used in Fly-by-Wire systems.
